withdrawal_queued.meaning: user has queued a kHYPE withdrawal via queueWithdrawal

queue_rate_used.meaning: exchange rate at queue time was used to determine the HYPE amount the user can withdraw

min_period_elapsed.meaning: the minimum withdrawal period (7 days minimum) has ended before confirmation

rate_decreased_between.meaning: the exchange rate decreased during the period between queue and confirmation

bank_run_risk_occurs.meaning: a bank run risk is created (potential impact reported for the stale-rate withdrawal scenario)

assumptions: The exchange rate decrease between queue and confirmation is treated as an external/potential event, not attacker-induced.
The HYPE amount paid on confirmation is determined by the rate at confirmation time in a lawful execution.
The bank run risk is a potential consequence of stale-rate withdrawals, not an inevitable outcome.

unresolved.description: Report does not define a numeric or observable relation linking the stale queue-time rate to the creation of bank run risk; only a qualitative potential impact is stated.
Exact exchange-rate formula and fee handling are unspecified, so the confirmation-time rate cannot be bound as a numeric quantity.

limitations: Bank run risk is encoded as a qualitative Boolean because the report gives no numeric threshold or magnitude for it.
The potential modality of bank_run_risk is preserved by treating it as a forbidden outcome under the stated scenario rather than an inevitable effect.
The confirmation-time exchange rate is not modeled numerically because the report omits its formula.
